ingest_plan: Download the four booklets from the official URL once supplied; record URL, date and sha256 here.
Ingest one booklet code (50 unless the URL set suggests otherwise) with its final-key column; record the other codes' option-order mapping only if NTA's booklets allow it.
Record dropped questions as dropped and two-answer entries with both accepted options; mark answer_challenged unverified.
Figures become media requests; Hindi is ours unless NTA's Hindi booklet is also supplied, then use it (hi_source: official).
Link questions to graph concepts and compute neet-ug-2026 pyq_count and weightage from this one paper, stating the basis is one paper.
